description_en: Having already lost its original structure, this building stands north of the lane at Ichẽ ṭola in Kirtipur. It used to be a three-bayed Phalcā.Ichẽ Cibhāḥ Phalcā used to be one of dozens of medievalphalcās in Kirtipur. Dating back to the 17thcentury, it is by now replaced by a two-storeyed concrete building. The Phalcā in its previous state can be seen on a photograph published byHerdick(1988, p. 115). In the 1990s, the state had constructed tanks for water storage at various localities in Kirtipur. After a consensus among the concerned parties, a water tank was constructed after the Phalcā was dismantled. The present building was constructed on top of the tank. Kirtipur Municipality allocated a budget of NRs 2,364,000 in 2020 CE (VS 2076) to give the building a facelift and provide a "traditional look". The budget was used to cover the building withdaciaḥpāwhile also installingsãjhyāḥand struts. It was inaugurated by local representatives in 2020 CE.An inscription and a stone statue of Triratna are still there as remnants of the medieval Phalcā. The inscription states that the Phalcā and aśikharakūṭa caityain front of it were constructed by Rāmahari Bhāro and his wife Rudrāyanī Mayi, residents of Sataḥkva ṭola in Kirtipur, together with 24 other individuals in 1698 CE (NS 818). It also states that a statue of Triratna was also installed at the same time. The inscription also gives instructions on performing anniversary rituals and other worships and records the formation of aguthiby donating some 10ropanīs of land at various places to carry out the rituals. Only the anniversary ritual is still performed today. Every year on the full moon day of Āśvina, a Rājabhaṇḍārī family from Sataḥkva ṭola, the descendants of the sponsor of the Phalcā, come here to perform the anniversary ritual of the Phalcā and thecaitya(local knowledge, local resident, Maharjana, male, age 83).
description_ne: कीर्तिपुरमा भएका दर्जनौं मध्यकालीन फल्चाहरू मध्ये यो पनि एक हो । इछेँ टोलको सडक किनारामा (उत्तर) यो फल्चा अवस्थित छ । १७ औं शदीमा तीन कवलमा निर्मित फल्चा भत्काइ दुई तल्ले कंक्रिटको संरचना निर्माण गरिएकाले विगतको फल्चा पूर्णत: नष्ट भैसकेको छ । ठिक यही ठाउँमा भएको विगतको फल्चाHerdick(1988, p. 115) द्वारा प्रकाशित फोटोमा देख्न सकिन्छ । तीन कवलको फल्चामा एकपाखे छानो भएको र झिंगटीले छाइएको तथ्य उक्त फोटोबाट निर्क्यौल गर्न सकिन्छ । सन् १९९० को दशकमा राज्य पक्षबाट कीर्तिपुरका विभिन्न टोलहरूमा पानी ट्याङ्की निर्माण गरिएको थियो । इछेँ टोलमा प्रस्तावित ट्याङ्की यही फल्चा भत्काई बनाउने सहमती बनेपछि ट्याङ्की बन्यो र पछि ट्याङ्कीमाथि दुईतल्ले भवन उठाइएको हो । उक्त भवनको बाह्य हिस्सालाई (facade) परम्परागत रूप दिन कीर्तिपुर नगरपालिकाले विसं २०७६ (सन् २०२०) मा रकम रू. २३, ६४,०००/- निकासा गरेको थियो । यस बजेटबाट उक्त दुईतले भवनको बाह्य भित्ता दाचि अप्पाले ढाक्ने, सँझ्या: र टुँडाल हाल्नुका साथै परम्परागत पाखेछानो हाल्ने कार्य गरिएको थियो । नयाँ रूप दिने कार्य सम्पन्न भए लगत्तै कीर्तिपुर नगरपालिकाका मेयर, उपमेयर र वडाअध्यक्ष्यहरूको उपस्थितिमा नेसं ११४१ कार्तिक शुक्ल पूर्णिमाका दिन (2020-12-30) भवनको समुद्घाटन भएको थियो ।हालको कंक्रिट संरचनामा मध्यकालीन फल्चाको अवशेषका रूपमा एक अभिलेख र त्रिरत्नको शिलामूर्ति सुरक्षित छ । प्राप्त अभिलेखको विवरण अनुसार यस फल्चाका साथै अगाडिको शिखरकूट चैत्यको निर्माण कीर्तिपुर, सतःक्व टोल निवासी रामहरि भारो, उनकी पत्नी रुद्रायनी मयि, भतिज विश्वेश्वर भारो लागायत अन्य २३ जनाको सहभागितामा नेसं ८१८ (सन् १६९८) मा भएको हो । सो समय फल्चामा त्रिरत्नको मूर्ति पनि स्थापना गरिएको कुरा अभिलेखमा उल्लेख छ । निर्माण पश्चात निर्माताले यी धार्मिक संरचनाको वर्षवर्द्धनका साथै प्रतिवर्ष सम्पन्न गर्नुपर्ने अनेक पूजाको निर्देशन दिइएको छ । जीर्णोद्धार र पूजा संचालनमा लाग्ने खर्चको आयस्ता स्वरूप निर्माताले विभिन्न ठाउँमा करिब १० रोपनी जग्गा दान गरेको प्रसंग पनि अभिलेखमा उत्कीर्ण छ । अलिभेखमा गुठीले वर्षेनी विभिन्न तिथिहरूमा सम्पन्न गर्नुपर्ने अनेक पूजा एवं परम्पराहरूको उल्लेख परे तापनि हाल यहाँ वर्षवर्द्धन पूजा मात्र जीवन्त छ । उल्लेखित अन्य परम्पराहरू लोप भैसकेका छन् । फल्चा निर्माताका दरसन्तान अर्थात् कीर्तिपुर सत:क्व टोल निवासी राजभण्डारी परिवार प्रतिवर्ष आश्विन शुक्ल पूर्णिमाका दिन फल्चा र चैत्यको वर्षवर्द्धन पूजा गर्न आउने गरेका छन् (local knowledge, local resident, Maharjana, male, age 83) ।

historical_events.event_description: Rāmahari Bhāro, his wife Rudrāyani and nephew Viśveśvara Bhāro jointly constructed a phalcā and established a statue of Triratna inside the Phalcā. Moreover, they also constructed the caitya in front of it. At the end of the inscription text it is mentioned that 23 persons had also contributed to establishing these monuments. They also made an arrangement of regular income for the annual rituals and the renovation of the caitya and Phalcā whenever necessary. Those whose duty it is to take care of the temple are mentioned as a group of four Bhāros, including Cikuti Bhāro, Viśvarāma Bhāro, Śaśideva Bhāro and Rāmarāja Bhāro. Members of the guṭhī include Bhāro (Śreṣṭha) community from across Kirtipur. Other details recorded are the position of the planets, the people to be invited and the list of things that must be used in the annual rituals.

There was a three-bayed Phalcā exactly at the place where the concrete building has been erected today. As remains from the older phalcā, an inscription and a statue of Triratna have been embedded into the new building. The Phalcā was dismantled and replaced by a water tank in the middle of the 1990s. Thereafter, a two-storeyed building was erected on the water tank. That building has been using by a social organization - Kirtipur Vācanālaya for decades.

Kirtipur municipality planned to beautify the two-storey building in a "traditional" way. The facade of the building was covered withdāci appā, struts and sãjhyāḥ were installed and the concrete slab of the top was replaced with a tiled roof. The task was completed in 2020 September and inaugurated by the Mayor of the municipality on the 30th day of November 2020.
